name: Malkav
source:
A freak-quency guardian. She acts as the ring announcer during freak-quency battles. She is responsible for setting up the matches, deciding who goes against who. Her freak is capable of analyzing other quency's freaks.

[spoiler]Age: 19 years old

Her real name is Rin, and she is Rick's supposed dead sister. [/spoiler]
